current_flow: mis-statement renders the Financial MIS for a resolved selection and exports it to Excel. The budget workbook's outline is persisted as a per-batch snapshot with a stable leaf key (decision 0021), so the statement mirrors the plan at its natural uneven depth without ever storing a parent amount. The statement reads its own governed projection at leaf/month grain (decision 0022) - filtering Actuals by the master's resolved triples before aggregating, per 0017 - while the shipped (gl_code, month) relation is left untouched, which is what lets the three multi-component GLs split across Primary, Secondary and Tertiary. Parents are derived subtotals, the unmapped-GL line stays visible, both zero states stay distinct, arithmetic is exact paise rounded only for display, and the Excel export is built from the same payload the screen renders. Four sequential tasks: statement-model, statement-api, statement-view, statement-export.
new_abstractions: a per-batch budget outline snapshot carrying structure but never money
a stable statement leaf key that survives a reordered or reissued workbook
a second governed shape: the statement projection at leaf/month grain
the provisional budget-leaf to SAP (cost centre, GL) correspondence in the master
gaps: The draft stored the outline as a parent_key on the budget LEAF rows, but decision 0020 persists leaves only - so parent_key would point at a parent node that is never stored, and '9 Admin Expenses' has TWO parent levels, which 0020's wording did not anticipate.

The leaf key was the workbook's sheet ROW NUMBER (lineId, set by the D-0029 fix), so any reissued or reordered workbook would silently repoint every Mapping Master entry targeting it - a silent financial misattribution.

The draft claimed the statement could change the governed roll-up's grouping key from gl_code to 'governed line' while decisions 0016/0017 stayed 'unchanged'. That is wrong on both counts: it IS a change of governed shape, and the shipped mis-selection route, the semantic domain and the planned drill-down all deliberately read GL-month rows.

FALSE CLAIM in the draft: 'the parser already walks the outline to decide what is a subtotal'. It does not - it tests each row's Budget cell formula independently (isSubtotal), which excludes subtotals but builds no tree. Constructing the outline is new work.
The plan was missing its Decisions, Risks and Verify Plan sections entirely.
Surface Impact was prose rather than classified rows, so a reader could not see what is new, changed or deliberately unchanged.
The endpoints had no DTO, auth or Swagger detail, so the plan did not say how the statement routes are shaped, guarded or documented.
The decomposition's third task spanned backend and frontend in one unit (the Excel export), which is not a bounded task.
Decision 0020 had to be reconciled before decomposition, since the outline work contradicts its one-parent-level assumption.
resolutions: HUMAN-decided (round): the outline is persisted as its OWN per-batch snapshot - the ordered section/component/leaf tree with S.No, label and ordering - and never as columns on the amount rows. Recorded as decision 0021, which amends 0020 to an outline of arbitrary depth while leaving its substantive rule intact.

HUMAN-decided (round): each leaf carries a STABLE key derived from its identity, never its sheet row number, so a reordered workbook maps onto the same lines. The July batch is re-uploaded once to carry the snapshot; a batch ingested earlier has none and must be re-ingested rather than guessed at. Recorded in decision 0021.

HUMAN-decided (round): the statement reads a SEPARATE governed projection at leaf/month grain and the shipped (gl_code, month) relation is left exactly as it is. Recorded as decision 0022 as an explicit NEW governed shape - not as '0016/0017 unchanged' - with 0016 section 2's deferred Budget-label mapping taken up here, provisionally. The plan now also requires the six existing gated proofs to pass unchanged as the evidence that promise was kept.
CORRECTED in the plan: the Technical Approach now states plainly that the parser does not walk the outline today and that building the tree is new work, not a rewording of what exists.

ADDED: Decisions (eleven attested), Risks (five, each with its mitigation) and Verify Plan (verify.py, build:frontend, a gated D-0008 proof with a dead-port negative control, the six existing proofs unchanged, and the functional check).

REWRITTEN as a classified table of eight rows - new / changed / unchanged - naming the warehouse schema and views, the ingest and mapping changes, the API and contract additions, the frontend view, and what stays untouched.

ADDED a 'Routes and DTOs' section: both routes sit under the existing api/mis controller per decision 0019, behind the same SessionGuard and governed report grant, with @ApiProperty DTOs beside mis-selection.dto.ts, and the unresolvable-vs-403 split preserved.
SPLIT into four tasks so none spans backend and frontend: statement-model, statement-api, statement-view, statement-export.

Decision 0020 AMENDED in place with a dated note pointing at 0021: the one-parent-level caveat is superseded by the arbitrary-depth snapshot; its rule that a cell-referencing formula marks a derived subtotal, and that no parent amount is ever stored, is unchanged.
open_items: The roll-over rule from Srihari stays open; the column renders unpopulated.
The budget-leaf correspondence is provisional until Srihari confirms it, exactly as the unmapped-GL bucket is.
One filled month of Srihari's Financial MIS remains the golden reconciliation reference.

summary: One cold read returned nine findings against the plan draft, two of them root decisions that blocked everything downstream. Seven were repository-answerable and are fixed in the amended plan: the false claim that the parser already walks the outline is corrected (it tests each row's formula independently and building the tree is new work); the missing Decisions, Risks and Verify Plan sections are written; Surface Impact is now eight classified rows; the routes gain DTO, auth and Swagger detail under decision 0019; the export task is split so no task spans backend and frontend, giving four tasks; and decision 0020 is amended in place to drop its one-parent-level assumption. The two root decisions went to the human and are recorded as decisions 0021 and 0022: the outline is a per-batch snapshot keyed by a stable leaf key rather than a parent_key on row-numbered leaves, and the statement reads its OWN governed projection at leaf/month grain while the shipped GL-month relation stays untouched - recorded honestly as a new governed shape, with the six existing gated proofs required to pass unchanged as the evidence. Verdict pass.
